docs.summary: The editor's one inline rename. A caller starts it with [`Begin`](#api~Prowl.Editor.GUI.Popups.RenameOverlay~Begin) and draws it with [`Draw`](#api~Prowl.Editor.GUI.Popups.RenameOverlay~Draw) in place of the item's label. Enter or a click anywhere else commits, Escape cancels. The text starts focused and selected, and a rename whose item stops being drawn, such as one scrolled away or in a closed panel, cancels.
Whether a rename operation is currently active.

docs.summary: Begins renaming an item, cancelling any other rename. onConfirm gets the trimmed text, onCancel runs on Escape, on blank text, and when the item stops being drawn.
Cancels the active rename operation and invokes the onCancel callback.
Returns true if a rename operation is active and targets the specified itemId.
Runs once per editor frame after the panels drew, to cancel a rename nobody draws any more.
